concepts.gloss_en: Speech/utterance — the divine speech, 'ruach piv' of the Holy One, aspect of Malchut/mouth (peh) and the gevurot; plural = utterances

reason_for_human: All 37 occurrences are the noun דִּבּוּר 'speech' — every vocalized instance reads דִּבּוּר, and the context is uniformly the mystical 'speech' aspect (mouth/Malchut, gevurot, nefesh, Shechinah). דִּבּוּרִים is the plain plural of the same word (utterances), not a homograph, so it belongs to the same concept. No verb forms (מְדַבֵּר) or דָּבָר 'thing/word' are mixed in.
